Name: The Farm
Author: ariasonata
Description:
Hello! This is The Farm, with waterfalls, an entire orchard area, crop circle plots large enough for a scarecrow per plot, a private beach, and so much more!

Fair warning, there is quite a bit of debris on this farm. If planning to play single-player, you have your work cut out for you! 
** This replaces the 4 Corners Farm Map

This farm can be played multi-player, however, buildings will not be spawned on creation, you will need the others that join your game to go to Robin's and build themselves a house. It's very cheap to do so, no worries there!

As always, I want to thank my friends for supporting my endeavors, as I would have never published anything without their encouragement, and do let me know what issues you find. 
I hope you enjoy it!


Listen.. this is a massive farm. I mean massive. I would give the advice of installing tractor mod, automate, ect. And please do remember, if you want a cozy farm.. this one's pretty but.. idk about cozy haha.

The recolor you see in this farm is Wittily with a few tree packs in AT form, and Darker Dirt and Cliffs. The house is the japanese house that I personally converted to AT. As for the other recolors... a lot of them are huge personal edits I've done in the past for myself, so I may or may not be able to tell you where they're from.

Don't forget Daisy's tilesheets, and have fun!
